contracts.name: StudyCommercialTutorInvocation

contracts.name: BoundedCommercialProviderRequest
contracts.reason: Serialized minimized request sent across the commercial provider boundary.

contracts.name: BoundedCommercialProviderResponse
contracts.reason: Serialized bounded response received from the commercial provider boundary before validation.

contracts.name: StudyCommercialTutorAdvisory
contracts.reason: Serialized non-authoritative advisory returned to the Study runtime.

contracts.name: StudyCommercialEffectReceipt
contracts.reason: Durable receipt used to reconcile acceptance of a Study-owned effect.

contracts.name: CommercialOperationTelemetryEvent
contracts.reason: Serialized minimized telemetry emitted for commercial operation observability.

contracts.name: ParentReport
contracts.reason: Serialized authorized report delivered across the parent-reporting boundary.

contracts.name: InstructionalMemoryDelta
contracts.reason: Recoverable serialized delta used to reconcile bounded instructional memory effects.

contracts.name: DurableMultimodalEvidence
contracts.reason: Durable minimized evidence persisted after multimodal projection; raw media, transcripts, biometric identity, and diagnostic inference are excluded.

contracts.name: MinimizedAcceptedStudyEffectEvent
contracts.reason: Durable minimized acceptance event replayed for effect and instructional-memory reconciliation without raw provider, tutor, or learner data.

contracts.name: PresentationIntent
contracts.reason: Serialized only as a closed nested member of StudyCommercialTutorAdvisory.

contracts.name: CommercialProviderTransport
contracts.reason: Transport input exists only for the live request attempt and is not a durable artifact.

contracts.name: RawAudioImageInput
contracts.reason: Raw media is an in-memory transient capability and is prohibited from durable evidence.
